professionalSummary.text: Pricing analyst in the motor pricing team of a personal lines insurer for three years, refreshing rating factors from claims and quote data each quarter under the team's refresh procedure.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared eleven rate change proposals with impact analysis, each approved or amended by the pricing committee with committee decision recorded on the proposal.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran pricing model monitoring monthly and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team, recorded in the monitoring log.
